decisive_items: Positron emission tomography–computed tomography showed osteolytic destruction of the neural arch of T9
Contrast-enhanced thoracic magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated an inflammatory lesion of the T9 lamina and a posterior epidural abscess compressing the spinal cord at T9–T10
response.rationale: Osteomyelitis is supported by the patient's history of back pain and imaging findings of osteolytic destruction, while Spinal epidural abscess is also a strong candidate due to the patient's symptoms and imaging findings, but Osteomyelitis is more specific to the bone destruction

rejected.why: Discitis is less specific and does not fully account for the osteolytic destruction and epidural abscess
